_note: Screen: Hyperbolic hierarchical embedding: per head an MLP of the SupCon-head shape embeds the image in a Poincare ball; classes, and the crop families / disease groups, are learned prototypes classified by hyperbolic distance, with a pull of each class prototype towards its group prototype (dpd/alt_terms.py); no SupCon. Declared ingredient: the taxonomy table. Prototype learning rate is 10x the head rate (needed for prototypes to move). Screening run (validation only, training data only): identical for every approach, so they can be compared fairly. Same ConvNeXt-Base, two-view batches of 64 images, cross-entropy heads (dropout 0.2, label smoothing 0.1), AdamW 5e-5 / 5e-4, weight decay 0.05, cosine schedule over 8 epochs, 3 validation splits (seeds 42, 43, 44), gamma grid 0-40 step 0.25, scoring by the cross-entropy heads. Only the term under test differs. No final fit and no test evaluation (training.stage1_only); the result is the mean validation harmonic mean at the best (epoch, gamma), read from stage1.json.
_result: Screening (validation only, training data only, 8 epochs, 3 splits): mean validation HM 57.34 (per split 50.3 / 58.0 / 63.7), epoch 5, gamma 6.75, HM at gamma 0 5.3; versus barebone SupCon -1.13, versus cross-entropy only -0.81. Read differences under about 1.5 points as no difference (single seed per split).

model._note: ConvNeXt-Base from timm, ImageNet-22k pretraining then 1k fine-tuning; drop_path_rate is stochastic depth. ce_dropout matches the baseline's head dropout.

input._note: Bicubic resizing, as ConvNeXt was pretrained.

augmentation._note: Same as the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline.

loss._note: Term under test: hyperbolic. Everything else as the barebone SupCon recipe.

scoring._note: CHANGED: mode heads, the cross-entropy heads' log-probabilities. temperature is only used for the prototypes saved alongside.

optimizer._note: As the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline (lr_head also covers the projection and cross-entropy heads).

training._note: Short screening schedule, same for every approach: 8 epochs, validation stage only.

runtime._note: grad_checkpointing: recompute backbone activations in the backward pass; identical gradients, less GPU memory, somewhat slower. Needed because ConvNeXt-Base with 128 views per step did not fit in 16 GB.
